newsitem.title: USA: LSI Logic 2nd-quarter profit flat on slow chip sales.
newsitem.headline: LSI Logic 2nd-quarter profit flat on slow chip sales.

text.p: LSI Logic Corp. on Thursday reported slightly weaker-than-expected second-quarter earnings amid slow sales of its computer chips.

LSI, which makes specialised chips for computer makers and consumer electronics companies, said it had net income of $46.8 million, or 32 cents a share, compared with $46.5 million, or 34 cents, in the same quarter a year ago. Earnings per-share fell as the number of shares outstanding rose 10 percent to 145 million.
Wall Street expected LSI, based in Milpitas, Calif., to earn 33 cents a share, according to a recent analyst survey by Zacks Investment Research.
Second-quarter revenue rose 2 percent to $332 million from $325.4 million.
The chip industry is still recovering from a glut of products, LSI said.
The chip maker announced its earnings after markets closed. Earlier, LSI fell $1.875 to $34.75 on the New York Stock Exchange.
